rationale: Asoma brings deep expertise in computational chemistry and materials informatics from his research at Resonac, while Vinav is actively exploring AI applications in materials discovery as a Stanford CS student at Periodic Labs. They're working in adjacent spaces—Asoma's published work on molecular dynamics simulation and force field optimization directly complements the computational approaches Vinav is developing, creating a natural mentorship and technical exchange opportunity.
intro_message: Asoma Yuichiro, meet Vinav Shah — both of you are applying computation to materials science, and Asoma's published work on molecular dynamics and Bayesian optimization could directly inform the AI-driven materials discovery Vinav is exploring at Periodic Labs.
